description: Cycle Counts DCC is a dataset listed in Ireland national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Dublin City Council. Bicycle traffic volumes from cycle counters in Dublin city. Bike counter include one Totem counter (Grove Road) and Eco-Multi counters using Zelt Diamond loop in a number of other locations. Locations include: Drumcondra, Charleville Mall, North Strand Rd, Guild Street, Richmond Street and Grove Road. Coverage: Dublin City Council. The portal files it under the publisher Dublin City Council. Its tags are city centre, mobility, traffic-counts, traffic-management. It offers 29 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, PNG, XLS, XLSX. The portal shows 2026-09-22 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ie-portal.
